shape: monorepo, two runtimes (python backend + next frontend), one sqlite file, one Caddy in front

layers.name: presentation
conventions: one surface (one URL) — the whole treasurer view is `/`
one panel open at a time; opening one closes another
PanelShell owns focus return, escape, scrim

layers.name: services
layers.purpose: business logic; the CheckEngine lives here

layers.name: repo
layers.purpose: sqlalchemy queries only, no business logic

layers.name: models
layers.purpose: sqlalchemy declarative base; single file for the whole schema

cross_layer_rules.dates: ISO 8601 text (SQLite has no date type)

invariants: Every path into the book runs one CheckEngine (deposit ticket, planner allocation, FX hedge initiation).
AI never books a deal. AI writes prose and picks from a whitelist; deterministic code checks and commits.
Counterparty exposure and currency exposure are separate concerns — different tables, different units, no query joins them.
Money is integer pence; never floats.
Rates are integer basis points; never floats.
One tenant now, schema supports many (tenant_id on every operational row).
Every change to a policy or a limit creates a new versioned row; old rows are marked superseded_at, not deleted.
The Treasury Register Connector is FIRST-PARTY — never named 'Oracle Integration Cloud' anywhere in code or UI.
traffic_flow_production: Next.js → same-origin /api/* rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8000 (env TREASURY_API_ORIGIN)
FastAPI → SQLite file (backend/app.db) + optional Groq HTTPS for AI paths
gaps_from_enterprise_grade: no observability stack (structured logs / metrics / traces / alerting)
no persona pages (admin / compliance / approvals) — treasurer only
in-memory settings singletons reset on process restart
